notes: Often written with a nuqta as क़िस्मत (qismat). A more formal Sanskrit synonym is भाग्य (bhāgya).
Often contrasted with कर्म (karma): कर्म refers to one's own actions and their consequences, while किस्मत refers to chance or pre-ordained fate.

draftBefore.emotion: hopeful and reflective, pondering the turns of life
notes: किस्मत (kismat) is an Arabic loanword widely used in Hindi and Urdu to mean fate or destiny. It is grammatically feminine, so adjectives and verbs modifying it agree with the feminine gender (e.g., अच्छी किस्मत).
It is often contrasted with कर्म (karma), where karma emphasizes personal actions and consequences, while किस्मत emphasizes pre-ordained fate or fortunate coincidence.

senses.definition: Good things that happen by chance; favorable fortune.
